default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1048.title: Dollar leads the index
E-1048.hypothesis: WDO moves first when macro news hits; if the dollar jumps while WIN has not yet fallen, the index catches down (and vice versa), so trade WIN against the unreacted leg.

E-1049.title: Bollinger band re-entry fade
E-1049.hypothesis: A close outside a k-sigma band of the recent closes followed by a close back inside signals an exhausted push; trade back toward the mean.

E-1050.title: Narrowest-range bar break
E-1050.hypothesis: A bar with the smallest range of the last n bars shows compression; a close beyond its extremes on the next bar releases the stored energy.

E-1051.title: VWAP z-score fade
E-1051.hypothesis: When the price stretches k standard deviations of its own recent VWAP deviation, late chasers are exposed and the price drifts back toward VWAP.

E-1053.title: US-session window range break
E-1053.hypothesis: Around the US cash open (10:30-11:30 BRT) foreign flow arrives; a close beyond the preceding range within 45 minutes of the start follows that flow.

E-1054.title: Round-number level rejection
E-1054.hypothesis: Limit orders cluster at round index levels; a bar that pokes through a round level and closes back under (over) it is absorbed there, so fade it.

E-1055.title: Volume climax at a new extreme
E-1055.hypothesis: A heavy-volume bar that makes a new session extreme but closes in its far half shows absorbed aggressive flow; fade it.

E-1056.title: Previous close reclaim
E-1056.hypothesis: The prior session close is where overnight holders are flat; the first close across it after the price sat on the other side for a while shifts the day's bias; follow.

E-1057.title: Index leads the dollar
E-1057.hypothesis: Sharp WIN moves reflect risk-on/off flows that usually push the dollar the opposite way; if WDO has not yet moved against a sharp WIN move, trade WDO toward it.
